additional_info.subject: 0442052 - ID0442052-DC/SI-D/AT-[Y2/S7 313782532001]dispenser warning: selftest has failed CRM:00271000945
additional_info.body:
Hello,
During each boot-up of the dispenser, a self-test is performed where the cooling fans are power-cycled on and off multiple times in short-duration cycles by the dispenser PLC. If the "OK" signal from the fan is not received after the ON command is issued, the system flags a self-test error.
Possible solutions to investigate:
Check the electrical wiring of the cooling circuit for tightness and proper connections.
Ensure that the cooling air filters are clean and not obstructing airflow.
Perform preventive maintenance and observe the behavior over multiple reboots. If the self-test continues to fail, it may be an early indication of a potential fan failure. In such cases, it is advisable to consider ordering spare parts.
That said, I believe a reboot should resolve the issue. This does not impact the charger’s functionality, as the fans are currently operational (verified via SSH). It’s likely that during the boot-up phase, the dispenser failed to send the "OK" signal to the main PLC, causing the error flag to be acknowledged.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen/ Best regards,Francois WINCKEL
